field_definitions.title: string — descriptive title
field_definitions.evidence_source_ids: array of strings — investigation files or artifact paths
field_definitions.affected_pipeline_stages: array of strings — pipeline stages this taskcard repairs
field_definitions.affected_formats: array of strings — format IDs (e.g. fods, gnumeric)
field_definitions.current_state: string — valid state_id from state machine
field_definitions.allowed_paths: array of path patterns this taskcard may write to
field_definitions.forbidden_paths: array of path patterns this taskcard must NOT write to
field_definitions.prerequisite_taskcards: array of TCA-xxx that must be CLOSED_VERIFIED before this starts
field_definitions.authority_inputs_required: array — spec facts, requirements, or artifacts this taskcard needs as input
field_definitions.authority_outputs_expected: array — artifacts this taskcard produces as output
field_definitions.implementation_scope: string — precise description of what this taskcard does
field_definitions.non_goals: array of strings — explicitly what this taskcard does NOT do
field_definitions.blocking_gates: array — verification gates that block this taskcard's closure
field_definitions.validation_commands: array of shell commands to verify the taskcard's output
field_definitions.negative_tests_required: array — tests that must FAIL to confirm the problem is fixed
field_definitions.evidence_required: array of file paths this taskcard must produce
field_definitions.state_transition_rules: object — maps failure/success conditions to state transitions
field_definitions.rollback_plan: string — what to do if this taskcard fails
field_definitions.owner_lane: string — lane that owns this taskcard
field_definitions.independent_verifier_lane: string — lane that independently verifies this taskcard
field_definitions.final_state: string — valid terminal or INDEPENDENT_VERIFIED state
field_definitions.closure_criteria: array of strings — specific conditions required for closure
